scope: Local implementation of QR-2 sub-slice S4-1 (RC-Q37): the offline extension paper-capital-model with the insert-only declaration table paper_capital_models, its guards, a rollback that refuses while any declaration exists, the classifier, the CLI with --inspect and the grant entries. No route, store writer or server line uses it; nothing is installed on any environment.
method: An architecture auditor (Opus 5.5) wrote the S4 design and a second model (Fable 5.1) wrote an independent alternative; root took the Opus draft as primary and recorded the decisions. A coder (Sonnet 5.5) wrote S4-1; an independent architecture auditor (Opus 5.5) reviewed it and found that the rollback SQL could drop a declaration committed during the drop and that the race test could not catch a missing lock; root ruled; the coder fixed them; an independent tester (Sonnet 5.5) ran single-edit mutations after each round. A sole-runner tester then ran, with nothing else active, every test file that imports a changed module of this batch (found with git grep): 22 PostgreSQL files one file per process on a throwaway PostgreSQL 16.15 cluster (392 tests, 0 fail; 2 skipped by the TEMP-privilege environment gate in a file this batch did not change), the full unit suite (2214 tests, 0 fail, 6 skipped by platform gates, 9 todo) and the grant text test; every changed file had the same hash before and after. Nobody verified their own work.
hashNote: SHA-256 of the line-feed content as Git stores it.
result: test/postgres/paper-capital-model-migration.test.mjs 23 of 23 and test/postgres/runtime-grants.test.mjs 1 of 1 pass with 0 skipped; the grant text test passes.

mutations.round1: 11 of 12 killed; the survivor (non-decreasing effective time) is equivalent under the other clock rules.
mutations.round2: 4 of 4 killed (rollback SQL lock and row refusal, tool lock, foreign-key trigger check); the midnight wait in the test helper only guards a timing window and is not killable by design.

limits: Provisional until the owner decides the S4 items: next-midnight effective time, the full owner Bot set, withdrawal as a new SHARED_HYPOTHETICAL version, THB kept, the 1000-version cap.
The O12 export, the confirmed rollback and the restore rehearsal are S4-3; the plain rollback works only with zero declarations.
A data-only restore and logical replication of the table are not supported (header).
The same internal foreign-key trigger gap exists in the other extension classifiers and is a later hardening item.
No install was run on any environment.

rootAcceptance.statement: Root reviewed the agent reports, the rulings, the sole-runner verification and the final diff and accepted S4-1 as local engineering evidence for the QR-2 row. Acceptance changes no PM-1 credit by itself and deploys nothing.
